title: set_small_word_list() with default list changes SUBPHRASE behaviour (drops dash separators)
property: Calling set_small_word_list() with its default (SMALL) leaves titlecase output unchanged
input: titlecase('foo - the end') before vs after set_small_word_list()
expected: 'Foo - The End' both before and after (default list is unchanged)
actual: After set_small_word_list(), result is 'Foo - the End'
evidence: Module-level SUBPHRASE uses [:.;?!\-–‒—―][ ] but set_small_word_list rebuilds it with only [:.;?!][ ], while its default argument is SMALL, the same list used at import; resetting to the default should be a no-op.
